derived_by: dirtyloader.re.trace + memmap on the HEX image; transport by its NVIC-bracketed bpm store

loader.note: core 0.3: the C loader goes in free flash past the image (ends 0x601DD400); its state and the loaded mods go in the ITCM tail after the firmware's ITCM code (0x29B40) up to the end of the 6 ITCM banks (GPR17 0xAAAAAFFF = 192 KB). MPU region 1 (ITCM, RASR 0x07080025, read-only) is made read/write by core_early. load_at is the bl 0x6008FDA8 in setup() just after the card is mounted (0x6007A3FC at 0x6007F0BC) and before audio starts or the autosave loads: core_load reads the card there, because SdFat calls after setup() broke the firmware's own card reads. SdFat: FsBaseFile::open 0x600A0894 on the SdFs volume 0x200376EC (sdk/include/m8-headless/fw.h).

BOOT.note: main(): bl setup; BOOT handlers run once after setup() returns

TICK.note: main(): bl loop; TICK handlers run before every loop()

SERIAL.note: the m8c command parser (obj): drains USB serial into a 6-byte buffer and runs E/R/D/C/K/P/S. Called from loop and from the render screens' polling (24 sites); core's handler takes requests that start with 0xD1.

TEMPO.note: set_tempo(clock_owner, float bpm): bpm in s0, stored at [[0x60090A10]]+0x3C0 inside AudioNoInterrupts

notes: loop (0x6007F02C) is a b.w veneer to the real loop at 0x6007FC54.
Headless is a different build from Model:02 6.6.2A: the clock is no longer a fixed global (bpm sits at +0x3C0 of an object reached through a pointer), so 6.6.2A addresses do not carry over.
Pin 13 (GPIO7 bit 3, the Teensy LED) is not used by this firmware; it drives GPIO7 bit 10 (pin 6) in setup().
